cover.title: Recurring connections and payment methods
cover.subtitle: Recurring-capable connections across HBO Max's Asia Pacific, European and Latin American markets

regions.name: Asia Pacific
regions.headline: The large Asia Pacific markets run on global acquirers plus local direct debit; the small ones on the card schemes and wallets.
regions.note: The 20 largest of the 38 Asia Pacific markets where HBO Max is available (help.hbomax.com), ranked by 2025 nominal GDP (IMF). HBO Max does not publish subscribers by country.

regions.name: Europe
regions.headline: Every large European market has twenty or more card processors live, with SEPA Direct Debit, iDEAL, Bancontact and Klarna where they are used for subscriptions.
regions.note: The 20 largest of the 46 European and Central Asian markets where HBO Max is available (help.hbomax.com), ranked by 2025 nominal GDP (IMF).

regions.name: Latin America
regions.headline: Latin America adds the recurring local rails that matter for subscriptions: Pix Automático and NuPay in Brazil, Mercado Pago Wallet, Yape and Daviplata.
regions.note: All Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking markets where HBO Max is available (help.hbomax.com); Belize, Guyana and Suriname are served by the global schemes only. Puerto Rico rides on US acquiring.
